title: Kinship Trout — full journey (UBC trees rehearsal)
summary: All Opening-to-Rebirth interaction beats from the Kinship & Trout board, laid out as a compact loop on the UBC trees test ground. Positions are rehearsal values; the same journey swaps to the Berkeley creek sites via the site registry.

scanProvenance.creator: elantao29@gmail.com (Elan's organization), recorded by Botao Hu
scanProvenance.notes: Niantic site 'UBC trees' in Elan's organization. Asset 'UBC trees 1' completed 08/09/2026 09:03 PM from one contributing scan covering 570.49 m2; set to Production and its default-anchor payload recorded on 2026-08-09. Waypoint coordinates await onsite placement.

safety.shortText: Prototype complete. Remain attentive to the physical site.
safety.fullText: Use only in a supervised, dry test area. Place the jump point on level, unobstructed ground. Feed only the virtual animal; never feed wildlife.

provenance.notes: Bundled development fallback based on the supplied interaction descriptions. On 2026-08-03 the project was moved to Niantic Site Strawberry Creek South (187bbd62-4d21-480e-8f8d-e484754aa22b) and selected asset aa815b01-bed7-416c-9d52-b5aef03892f4. The portal showed that asset as not yet Production, so the old Tong anchor and payload were removed. Unity waypoint coordinates are authoring/simulation values until the new Production payload and onsite calibration are recorded. Audio was downloaded from the supplied Drive folder on 2026-07-30 and mapped as an MVP interpretation; authorship and license remain unverified.
